summary: Iteration 4 testing of g00dweird.com fullfunk + chat-overlay + thought-cloud features. Backend: 35/35 pytest PASSED (32 regression iter1+2+3 + 3 new iter4 covering chat fullfunk flag broadcast/persist, *think+fullfunk thought broadcast & snapshot thought_fullfunk, regular chat last_message.fullfunk=false in snapshot). Frontend Playwright desktop (1920x1080) + mobile (390x844): /fullfunk/{A,5,excl,dollar}.png all 200; toggle-fullfunk button label 𝔽𝕟𝕜 toggles active class + yellow bg (rgb(255,238,85)) + placeholder 'FULLFUNK MODE — msg renders as pixel glyphs'; sending 'HELLO 1!' under fullfunk produces [data-testid='fullfunk-chat'] containing exactly 7 glyphs (HELLO=5 + '1' + '!'); '*think DREAM' adds NO chat-message but creates [data-testid='thought-bubble'] with inner

issues: Chat-message rows on the semi-transparent (rgba 0.55) bg use textShadow:'0 0 3px #fff' for legibility — works fine over the bright pastel HELLO room bg, but in lower-contrast scenes (e.g. mars red mesas) light-coloured timestamp text (#333) on the rgba white overlay still has acceptable contrast (~7:1). No action needed; just noting design choice.

critical_code_review_comments: ChatWindow.jsx is now ~480 lines with iso world + chat overlay + resize + sidebar mixed in one component. Consider extracting (a) ResizeHandle + chatH state into a useResizableChat hook, (b) MessageRow into its own component, (c) sidebarContent into a Sidebar component. Same readability concern as previous iters but worse now.

FullfunkText loads a per character with no caching hint. For long messages this means many parallel HTTP requests; consider an HTTP cache header on /fullfunk/*.png served by the frontend (CRA serves them static, so default browser caching applies — should be OK, but worth confirming).

ChatWindow inline-style on resize handle uses bottom={chatH}; combined with the overlay using bottom:0, height:chatH — when chatH grows, the iso world above shrinks visually but the IsoWorld component itself doesn't know (it fills its parent and is just covered). That's intentional/acceptable but means the iso scene cannot be interacted with in the area covered by the chat overlay. Consider lowering overlay alpha further or adding pointer-events:none to a top portion of the overlay if you want users to still click avatars under it.

Server-side: ClientConn.last_message still has no age cap (8s expiry purely client-side). However room_user_list() now strips last_message older than 8s based on lm['ts'] — verified fix from iter3 review item #2 is implemented (server.py L243-250). Good.
*think with fullfunk:true sets conn.thought_fullfunk = fullfunk only when conn.thought is non-empty; bare '*think' (clear) correctly resets thought_fullfunk to False. Logic correct.
Frontend FullfunkText falls back to a font-pixel span with magenta color for unmapped characters (e.g. emoji). Reasonable graceful degradation.
